description: Health, throughput, latency and outcomes of the online-evaluation queue.

options.content:
A **work unit** is one span, trace or session paired with one evaluator. A running unit holds one evaluator concurrency slot; after a retryable error it waits out a cooldown, then runs again.

```
pending ─▶ running ─▶ evaluated | failed | expired
   ▲          │
   └─retrying─┘        cleared: removed while pending
```

Panel ⓘ icons explain each panel. The *Evaluation target* filter doesn't apply to concurrency or queue-limit panels.
